Mix: Blend between the input (0) and the effect (1).
Bypass: Pass in1 through unchanged; the effect does not cook.
Resolutionmode: input: follow in1's resolution (or the demo source when unconnected). custom: use Resolution.
Resolution: Output size in pixels when Resolutionmode is custom.
Speed: Zoom and animation rate. 1 = one lattice cycle per 8 seconds.
Innerscale: Scale of each nested copy of the image (0-1). Smaller = more repeats visible.
Zoomperiods: Integer number of nested-copy periods the zoom travels per cycle. Sign sets direction, 0 = no zoom.
Rotation: Spiral twist in turns gained per nested copy. 0 = straight tunnel.
Spin: Integer whole-image turns per cycle, for a seamless loop.
Fill: Fraction of the image radius sampled. 1 = the inscribed circle.
Center: Centre point of the tunnel (X, Y), in normalised coordinates.
Seam: Softens the seam between rings. 0 = hard.
Original: Blend in the un-warped image (0 = effect only, 1 = original).
Modamount: Strength of the in2 modulation CHOP (band1 pumps Innerscale). 0 = ignore.
